scenario: archive._bound_native reads an offset-less bound in the grid's partition_tz while archive._refuse_empty_range (#969) still reads it in the caller's TimeZone, so the two order a range differently across a DST gap in partition_tz: from a UTC session on an America/New_York 30-minute grid, '2024-03-10 02:30:00'..'03:00:00' passes the refusal (02:30Z < 03:00Z) but the Parquet encoder reads it as [07:30Z, 07:00Z), inverted, finds no row and PUTs an empty object at the live cell [07:30Z, 08:00Z)'s key; the PR body's claim that the refusal reads the same instant the encoder reads is not kept, and the call should be refused (or the refusal should compare the canonical bounds the encoder reads)
